reviewed_by: gpt-5.3-codex (independent batch-019 step-10 review; applied selectively at collation)
summary: Swizzle (.xx) on a template type parameter that resolves to a scalar fails with 'member reference base type is not a structure or union'; the same swizzle compiles fine when the parameter is declared as a literal scalar type or outside any template. Always-repro'd across every release with template support (v1.7.2308..v1.9.2607) and on main; templates did not exist before that. hlsl_clang_trunk (the new Clang-based HLSL frontend) compiles the exact repro cleanly, corroborating a prior maintainer comment that it works in clang.
title: Cannot do swizzle operations with floating type when it's a typename
